meta.description: Development level breakpoints and economic effects. Primary driver of factory eligibility, local supply generation, and long-term industrial output.

1.name: Rural / Frontier
1.description: Minimal industry. Suitable for light infantry and basic supply.

3.name: Developing Agricultural-Industrial
3.description: First real factories. Good for early motorized and support equipment.

5.name: Early Industrial Hub
5.description: Core 1930s–1940s industrial province. Full range of mid-war production possible.

7.name: Mature Industrial Base
7.description: High output and resilience. Excellent for sustained high-intensity warfare.

10.name: Advanced Industrial Complex
10.description: Late 20th century standard. Supports jet-era and early missile production at scale.

14.name: High-Tech Industrial Center
14.description: Modern precision manufacturing + strong R&D base. Critical for 21st century systems.

18.name: Strategic Megacomplex
18.description: Near-future peak. Enables megaprojects and off-world adjacent production.
